output.markdown:
## Average fare jumped 36.5% on MLK Day, but root cause remains unclear

On Monday 2025-01-20 (Martin Luther King Jr. Day), the average total amount per yellow taxi trip was $36.48, which is 36.5% higher than the mean of the other three Mondays in January 2025. Trip count (90,094) was within the normal Monday range, and average trip distance rose to 4.79 miles on 20 Jan. The fare-per-mile was higher on 20 Jan than on other Mondays, indicating a fare-mix shift rather than a pure distance effect. 2025-01-20 is confirmed as a federal holiday (Martin Luther King Jr. Day), while the other Mondays were not holidays. However, the yellow_daily aggregate table lacks PULocationID/DOLocationID columns, so zone-mix shifts and trip-level fare components cannot be assessed.

**Recommendation:** Obtain trip-level data (PULocationID, DOLocationID, itemized fare components) to test zone-mix and fare-mix hypotheses. In the interim, flag 2025-01-20 as a holiday-affected day for fare forecasting models, as the 36.5% spike is consistent with reduced competition and altered trip purposes on MLK Day.

### Evidence-backed claims
1. Avg total amount per yellow taxi trip on 2025-01-20 was 36.5% higher than the mean of the other three Mondays in January 2025 [Q1 · sha256:b3461d344ed78e7b · whybot.yellow_daily]
2. 2025-01-20 is a federal holiday (Martin Luther King Jr. Day) while the other three Mondays in January 2025 are not holidays [Q2 · sha256:d70f369f267f377e · whybot.us_holidays]
3. Yellow_daily table lacks PULocationID/DOLocationID columns, preventing zone-mix analysis at the aggregate level [Q6 · sha256:2a360318c3e6c9c0 · whybot.yellow_daily]
4. Average trip distance on 2025-01-20 was 4.79 miles, which is higher than the other three Mondays in January 2025 [Q6 · sha256:2a360318c3e6c9c0 · whybot.yellow_daily]

### Caveats
- Weather was significantly colder on 20 Jan (tmax -3.2°C, tmin -8.2°C) than other Mondays, which may have shifted trip mix but cannot be isolated without trip-level data.
- The yellow_daily aggregate table does not contain location IDs or fare-component breakdowns, so zone-mix and fare-mix mechanisms remain untested.
- Trip count on 20 Jan (90,094) is within the Monday range, so the spike in avg_total_amount is not a data-quality artifact of unusually low volume.
- Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 3 date(s): 2024-12-31: TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday=Y but Nager.Date says no national holiday; 2025-01-20: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day (national holiday); 2025-02-17: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Presidents Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:8441c7c602666af3].

_Confidence 0.85. Data source: LIVE Zetaris Lightning (JDBC)._

hypotheses.statement: Average total amount per yellow taxi trip on Monday 2025-01-20 was higher than the average of the other three Mondays in January 2025.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 > mean(avg_total_amount on 2025-01-06, 2025-01-13, 2025-01-27) by a meaningful margin (e.g., >5%).
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 is within normal variation of the other Mondays.
hypotheses.status_reason: Avg total amount on 2025-01-20 was 36.5 % higher than the baseline mean, well above the 5 % threshold.

hypotheses.statement: Monday 2025-01-20 is a federal holiday (Martin Luther King Jr. Day) while the other Mondays are not, altering demand composition.
hypotheses.support_if: us_holidays shows 2025-01-20 as a national holiday and the other three Mondays have no holiday.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2025-01-20 is not a holiday or the other Mondays also have holidays.
hypotheses.status_reason: 2025-01-20 is a federal holiday (MLK Jr. Day); the other three Mondays are not holidays.

hypotheses.statement: Weather on 2025-01-20 (precipitation, temperature extremes) differed from other Mondays, changing trip mix.
hypotheses.support_if: nyc_weather_daily shows rain/snow or extreme temps on 2025-01-20 but not on baseline Mondays.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather conditions are similar across all four Mondays.
hypotheses.status_reason: Precipitation/snow were similar, but 20 Jan was significantly colder (tmax -3.2 °C vs 4–6 °C on other Mondays). Cold temperature may have shifted trip mix toward longer, higher-fare trips; cannot isolate weather effect without trip-level data.

hypotheses.statement: The fare mix shifted on 2025-01-20 (e.g., more airport flat-fare trips, higher congestion surcharges) raising avg_total_amount without distance change.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance unchanged but avg_total_amount up; trip-level data shows higher share of airport/flat-fare trips.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance rises proportionally with avg_total_amount, or trip-level fare components show no mix shift.
hypotheses.status_reason: Avg trip distance rose ~12 % while avg fare rose ~36 %; fare-per-mile increased ~22 %. A fare-mix shift (e.g., more airport flat-fares, higher congestion surcharges) is plausible but cannot be confirmed without trip-level fare-component data.

hypotheses.statement: Pickup/drop-off zone mix shifted on the holiday Monday (e.g., higher share of airport–Manhattan trips) driving up average fare despite flat distance.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip-level data shows significantly higher proportion of trips to/from airport zones (JFK, LGA, EWR) or long-haul Manhattan zones on 2025-01-20 vs baseline Mondays.
hypotheses.refute_if: Zone mix proportions are statistically indistinguishable between the holiday and baseline Mondays.
hypotheses.status_reason: Zone-level data not available; proxy metrics (distance, trip count) show no clear shift. Cannot confirm or rule out zone-mix change.

hypotheses.statement: The spike is a data artifact (e.g., duplicate rows, missing trips, fare calculation bug) specific to 2025-01-20.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count or avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 is an extreme outlier vs all January Mondays; known TLC data issues on that date.
hypotheses.refute_if: Trip count and avg_total_amount are within normal ranges; no known data issues.
hypotheses.status_reason: Avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 is a statistical outlier vs the other three Mondays; trip count is normal, so a data-quality artifact is unlikely to be the sole cause.
